title: Free helpers for Guildborne modular character system
notes: All sources author/official upstream. No paid tier recommended or acquired.
Official Roblox downloadable references are not provenCC0/MIT or blanket redistributable. Archive licence inspection pending.
Quaternius whole-kit marketing counts are not free-tier inventory. Exact free model/animation counts null.
Current local articulation is recorded historically; this session did not rerun Studio tests.
Ordinary runtime uses Parts substitutes; isolatedEditableMesh preview does not bind liveplayer/hero/NPC.
Shared canonical body/clothing IDs, server save/entitlements and always-on coverage remain intact.
MPFB/Quaternius generic Humanoid skeletons are not approved RobloxR15 bodies/cages.
Research suggestions do not grant upload, publication, spending or cloud writes.

items.title: Roblox R15 rig, body cages and clothing cages
items.supportedFact: R15 rig/attachments, 15 body cages, full-body inner/outer clothing cages. Project files are for authoring, not direct Studio import.
items.fit: ใช้ cage topology/UV และ skeleton reference กับ Human Standard/Heavy และ tunic/trousers เดิม
items.requires: ปรับ cage ตามแต่ละหุ่น; inspect licence/archive; preserve vertices/UV correspondence.

items.title: Roblox body templates and Goblin reference
items.supportedFact: Starting character templates and a fantasy Goblin with full body cage are offered for examples/boilerplate/reference.
items.fit: ศึกษา head/body/rig/cage และสร้างหน้าตา Guildborne; Goblin เป็น reference ไม่ใช่ accepted Orc
items.requires: cleanup, original silhouette, neutral tint and 15 meshes; no automatic Heavy/Dwarf fit.

items.title: Roblox caged clothing examples
items.supportedFact: Uncaged T-shirt and caged layered accessory examples are separately listed.
items.fit: เทียบโครง garment/cage แล้วสร้าง tunic/trousers ของเกมให้เป็น layered จริง
items.requires: Archive contents unknown; no verified fantasy tunic/trousers or universal fit.

items.title: Avatar Setup — Development Avatar
items.supportedFact: Development Avatar preset targets NPC/starter characters. Tool can set up avatar components and preview animations/clothing; attachment and body cage edits are available.
items.fit: ทดลองบนสำเนา body+garments โดยเลือก workflow ให้ชัด
items.requires: Input requirements apply; preserve compatible R15 rig or tool may replace it. Do not assume existing candidate qualifies. No Save/upload/publish in research.

items.title: Accessory Fitting Tool
items.supportedFact: Custom bodies, animations and layered combinations can be previewed; minor fitting edits and Accessory hierarchy generation.
items.fit: ทดสอบ Standard/Heavy แบบcustom ทั้งใส่แยกและซ้อน tunic/trousers; rigid hair/hat offsets
items.requires: Classic/Normal/Slender selector does not affect layered accessories; not Heavy/Orc/Dwarf fit proof.

items.title: MPFB2
items.supportedFact: Blender human-generation workflow with free core assets. Release notes document Hair Editor support/fix for Blender4.2–5.2.
items.fit: ทางเลือกสร้างฐาน Human ที่ปรับสัดส่วน แล้วเก็บเป็น preset geometry; ไม่เพิ่ม runtime full-body sliders
items.requires: Specific documented compatibility is not local full-pipeline proof. Retopology, R15 split/rig/cages and art adaptation required. Addon dependencies/execution/telemetry unreviewed.

items.title: MakeHuman Hair01
items.fit: คัดทรงผมเป็น donor/reference แล้วลด geometry/ปรับรูปทรงและสีให้เข้ากับเกม
items.requires: Attach to existing HAIR IDs; per-head/preset fit; do not assume Roblox-ready.

items.title: MakeHuman Bodyparts05
items.supportedFact: Beards/moustaches including Viking beard are listed.
items.fit: คัดเครา/หนวดให้Human/Dwarf เป็นชิ้นแยกและ tint แยก
items.requires: rigid/skinned attachment choice, facial clipping and provenance review; no Dwarf fit confirmed.

items.title: Universal Base Characters — Standard only
items.supportedFact: Humanoid base and hairstyle kit; author advertises60–70% free, not exact free inventory.
items.fit: ศึกษา proportions/topology หรือคัด donor ที่อยู่ในfree tier
items.requires: Paid Source blend/shaders excluded. Humanoid rig is not Roblox R15/15-part/cage compatibility.

items.title: Modular Character Outfits — Fantasy Standard only
items.supportedFact: Modular fantasy clothing with Humanoid rig, designed for Universal Base Characters; author advertises60–70% free.
items.fit: คัดชิ้นเสื้อ/ชุดที่freeจริง เปลี่ยน silhouette/material แล้ว weight/rig/cage บนหุ่น Guildborne
items.requires: No62parts/all12outfits free claim. Paid Source blend excluded. Not a ready Roblox layered garment.

items.title: Universal Animation Library — Standard only
items.supportedFact: Locomotion/life/combat animation kit with root-motion/no-root-motion variants advertised for the whole library.
items.fit: คัดเฉพาะคลิปfree เพื่อศึกษา walk/idle/work poses และ retarget
items.requires: Do not claim120+free or each advertised clip inStandard. R15 mapping, grip/foot contact, game timing and animation ownership remain work.

productionSequence.work: Inspect selected official rig/cage/reference archives and licences; hash source; preserve original assets and canonical IDs.
Rig/cage actual HumanStandard and Heavy; preserve15 visible body meshes and separate skin/hair/garment materials.
Convert original CLO_TUNIC_TRAVELER_01 and CLO_TROUSERS_TRAVELER_01 into layered garments; author weights and inner/outer cages.
Test each item separately/together on both bodies with locomotion, sit/crouch, attack/cast, equip/remove/cleanup; validate tint/modesty.
Bind accepted originals through AppearanceAssetRegistry; preserve IDs/ownership/revisions; test Player/Hero paths and save/respawn/rejoin.
Adapter for both world NPC carriers preserving tags/tools/dialogue/quest/work/streaming, then expand remaining races/presets.

nextOwners: Character artist + rigging artist for inspected archives/original cages/garment fit; guild engineer for accepted Player/Hero/NPC adapters; QA for per-preset/tool/runtime/device evidence.
